action.objective: Commit Bxf6, the strongest verified move, winning the knight and keeping the e5 knight's fork pressure.
action.rationale: Both candidates are verified at depth 4. Bxf6 scores -129 vs Na4 -249 at shared depth 4; Bxf6 is clearly better. Bxf6 captures the f6 knight with the dark-squared bishop; Black recaptures exf6, then Ne5-f7 forks the king, e7 pawn and f6 pawn, forcing Kxf7 (score -129). Na4 lets the queen raid with 1...Qa5. Bxf6 also has complete safety: no immediate mating reply and no tactical refutation found. Both are commit_ready_moves, so no risk acceptance needed.
